title: RobotDescriptor
description: ohho.descriptor.v1 robot descriptor. Published latched as JSON on /ohho/descriptor. Safety hard caps are required. Their maximums are the OmniBot ceilings and must not be raised. A schema-valid descriptor is not permission to skip the producer safety gate, and it does not raise a tighter driver clamp.

arms.description: Arms. Empty when the robot has no arm.

cameras.description: Cameras. Empty when the robot has no camera.

apriltags.description: AprilTags fixed to the robot. Empty when none are installed. Do not invent a tag.
